description_zh: 调用DeleteVpcPrefixList接口删除前缀列表
kebab_example: aliyun vpc delete-vpc-prefix-list --prefix-list-id pl-0b78hw45f0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteVpcPrefixList

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the prefix list to delete
parameters.help_zh: 要删除的前缀列表的实例ID
parameters.name: prefix_list_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The ClientToken value can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request may be different
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId可能不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without deleting the prefix list. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and business restrictions. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the check succeeds, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the prefix list is deleted
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会删除前缀列表。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接删除前缀列表
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the prefix list to delete.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
要删除的前缀列表所在的地域ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/36063.html接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id
